ward.summary: Kurla (ward L) spent ₹1.30 crore against a ₹1.19 crore budget, or 110%, so it is over budget. Of 232 jobs, 18% were redone within 30 days, better than the 24% expected, which matters in a flood-prone ward (flood index 0.85). Even so, ₹18.2 lakh went on repairs that failed. Only 32% of jobs finished on time, against 47% expected. Twelve jobs are listed for review. Next, 48 open issues need ₹16.2 lakh, led by Kurla Andheri Road cave-ins. With ₹0 left, funds must be reallocated or recovered from warranty roads.
